method: Existing native room retained outside localized reconstruction; missing material/form information comes from the preserved clean-room source and is interpreted within old occluder masks using the existing palette plus native contour/cluster/threshold/floor work. Table/linen/glasses/napkins and props use separate native layers. Exact native bucket clusters translated42px without scaling; open handles kept. Wheel, wrapped spherical rubber-band fender, napkin knot and water are new native-grid localized layers. Generated clean underdrawing is interpreted only within the old occluder mask with existing material palette and native contour/cluster/threshold/floor corrections. No whole-image resize offered as finished art, no blur or procedural gradient. Exact native flower/vase and unobscured cloth clusters also translated without scaling.
